stem: Measles is a highly infectious disease. The World Health Organization (WHO) has coordinated a programme for controlling this disease by using vaccination.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Name the pathogen that causes measles.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Explain how the measles pathogen is transmitted.

parts.label: (b)
(c)
parts.text: Explain why measles has **not** yet been eradicated even though a vaccine has been available since the 1960s.
